quest.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Chit-Chat
quest.description: Nakul is looking for a suitable place to study...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Credit Coupons x280

dialogues.speaker: Nakul
dialogues.text: You two! Please wait. I hear you're... people of leisure... who never turn down a request.

choices.text: That is correct, indeed.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: *ahem* Actually, a girl in a purple dress asked me to take care of you.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: But I was thinking, since you accept any and all requests, you must be very capable. So I'd never need to take care of you. Indeed, it would be more accurate to say that you two can take care of me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, but no discounts.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: I know the rules, don't worry. Regardless of the outcome, I will compensate you according to market rates. But Mora is useless here, so I'll pay with Coupons.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll be compensated no matter what happens? Really?

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: Absolutely and totally correct! Our task is just that difficult, you see. It's that Nizami's fault for being great with his fists, but for using them where they shouldn't have been used.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: I'll be staying here for a while longer, so I need a place to pursue my studies. It's best if it has a bookshelf, a table, chairs, and a board to write on and stick materials to...

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: I'm sure you know exactly what place I'm talking about, but it's simply not available and there's no point in asking. But I believe that a room on the opposite side has the same internal structure, and should be usable.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: But it's a really strange place. It seems to be occupied by someone who rarely entertains visitors. I've never seen the person nor even seen the doors open.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: So I appointed Nizami as my representative. He was always reliable during the time I employed him as a bodyguard. However, he got into a disagreement with the occupant, and negotiations broke down.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Maybe communication and negotiations have never been his strong suit.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: Indeed. It didn't even look like a negotiation. He just hammered on the door with his fist, standing outside and shouting. It was a truly shocking moment for me.

choices.text: Whoa!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That doesn't sound like a negotiation at all!

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: As such, I'd like to ask you to act as my representative and negotiate with the occupant to rent out the space he is currently occupying. I expect the price to be... a maximum of 54,000 Coupons.

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: You may not succeed, and that's fine, but at least give it a try. I'm counting on you.

choices.text: How unprofessional.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon suspects he was never a professional when it comes to things like this...

choices.text: And just who told you that?

response.speaker: Nakul
response.text: Uh, well... Rumors... Just rumors...

talks.objective: Negotiate with the person behind the door

dialogues.speaker: Nakul
dialogues.text: If only I hadn't ticked off Carranza earlier, then maybe the negotiations would go more smoothly. *sigh*

talks.objective: Negotiate with the person behind the door

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (According to Nakul, non-Fontainians seem to be discriminated against. Will he ignore us as well? Is there a better way to go about this?)

choices.text: A nameless traveler, an adventurer crossing all the nations of the world.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: ...Since when did this place become a scenic attraction?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Stop playing around, {NICKNAME}. Don't forget what we're here for.

choices.text: We were asked to discuss something with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... We were hired to ask about renting this room of yours. Of course, the client will be happy to pay you in Coupons!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Something similar happened a while ago... That client of yours really refuses to give up, huh? You were sent by that guy with the really funky way of talking, weren't you?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Forget it, out of respect for his perseverance... Tell me his offer.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Yes! Looks like we've still got some room for communication!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Nakul told us about his expectation for the price. If we're making the offer, should we reveal his budget from the get-go? Or should we try getting a bargain?)

choices.text: (Let's just lay all the cards on the table.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, Paimon's telling it like it is! The client's budget is 54,000 Coupons. Paimon thinks it's a good deal.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Only 54,000? That's just 10% higher than when he had that psycho hammer on my door... What a miser.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Only? Paimon thinks it's a lot!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: You know nothing. Haven't you ever heard of Carranza? He's much more generous. He offered... Uh, he offered me 108,000!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? That much?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: O—Of course! Do I look like a liar to you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can't see anything from this side of the door!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (He didn't sound very confident. Maybe he made it all up to trick us.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(What's our negotiation plan now, {NICKNAME}?)

choices.text: (We honestly only have this much, so it's his if he wants it.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We told the truth from the start. We only have 54,000. 108,000 is crazy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you refuse, then... o—our hands are tied. We'll have no choice but to give up.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: I just have to wait a little longer... Just a little longer and it'll rise all the way up. I'll definitely get a higher offer when you return the next time, and the time after that!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: I never misinterpret the trends! It will go up! So I must hold on! I cannot rashly agree, cannot agree so easily...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there a reason you're so confident?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Experience, of course! Based on my last two experiences, the upward trend will continue if I don't interrupt it. Isn't that obvious?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of logic is that!?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: You're a child, so of course you don't understand. Anyway, it isn't the right time yet, so I won't agree. You can go now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well... It doesn't seem like he'll be changing his mind. Let's head back and pass the news to Nakul, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: (Since he's trying to play us, let's play him instead.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww... Paimon didn't expect we'd be up against a strong competitor like Carranza! It doesn't seem like we stand a chance!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's go, {NICKNAME}! We'll tell Nakul his offer was way too low to even be considered!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In the meantime, good luck with Carranza, Door Guy! Bye now!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Huh? You're leaving already?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Hey! Are you still out there?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Heyyyyy! Don't goooo! Come back real quick, please!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We could hear you shouting from all the way over there! What is it? Do you want us to get Carranza for you?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Oh, no, no! How could I trouble you like that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It's no trouble at all, and it's even on the way, right, {NICKNAME}? Something like that would be a piece of cake!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: *ahem*... You've got a real mean streak, don't you? Anyway, let's get down to business. Is your previous offer still valid?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: For now, but not for long.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Alright, I'll take it. But tell your client to come speak to me himself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alright! Let's head back and pass the news to Nakul, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: (It's hagglin' time! Let's put this price in the basement!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then... 27,000! What do you think about 27,000 Coupons?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: 27,000!? You kidding!? Are you here to insult me!? That offer's even lower than before!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: I didn't even accept the offer from that psycho who hammered on my door, and the offer was way higher then! So what makes you think I'd accept this one!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(What do we do, {NICKNAME}? Do we still stick to this offer?)

choices.text: The market price is falling, and it will only fall further.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Really? Doesn't Nakul really want this room? I'm sure he's willing to pay handsomely for it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Everyone has a limit to their patience! You've already rejected him firmly twice, so, y'know, maybe he's feeling discouraged.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's half now, and next time, it might be... Oh! Maybe there won't even be a next time!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: ...Let me... Give me time to consider.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Door Guy! You done thinking?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Alright, I'll take it. But tell your client to come speak to me himself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alright! Let's head back and pass the news to Nakul, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: (Let's raise it to match the client's budget.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... How about 54,000 Coupons then? It's double the last offer!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Only 54,000? That's just 10% higher than when he had that psycho hammer on my door... What a miser.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: And the way your offers keep fluctuating... I bet there's room to increase it even further!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: I just have to wait a little longer... Just a little longer and it'll rise all the way up. I'll definitely get a higher offer when you return the next time, and the time after that!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: You can go now. I won't accept your offer, at least this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well... It doesn't seem like he'll be changing his mind. Let's head back and pass the news to Nakul, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: (Try opening the door.)

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: ...Hey! Wh—What are you doing!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Opening the door? We can't even see each other's face like this, and it's always better to discuss things face to face!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it's not like the rooms here are anyone's private property, right? They're just temporary quarters, so we should be able to enter too.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: No! Of course not! You don't understand... Y—You don't know what kind of darkness is hiding on the other side...

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Uh, I mean... I get nervous and freeze up in front of people. So let's talk through this door. Anyway, what brings you here?

choices.text: We were asked to discuss something with you.

choices.text: (Keep trying to open the door.)

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: My goodness! Why won't you stop!? I told you that you don't know what kind of darkness is hiding on the other side...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How do we know you're real if we don't speak face to face?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Of course I'm real... And so what if I'm not real? It's the same for me too, I don't know if you're real either! But aren't we still talking to each other?

choices.text: I can pinch Paimon's cheeks! She looks very real.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Fine, I guess you two can prove each other's existence.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Anyway, I refuse to open the door, and I advise you to stop trying to open it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh*... But we were hired to inquire about renting this room of yours.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Then you should tell him to give up. There doesn't need to be another who is one with the darkness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've been going on about the darkness for awhile now. What are you talking about?

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: You sound like a child, and children will never understand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, Paimon thinks you're just making it all up to trick us!

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Haha! That's possible too! But I've said what I want to say, and this door will not open for you nor will I agree to rent out this room. Please leave now.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The voice behind the door vanishes.\nAfter waiting a bit, you knock on the door again but receive no response. It is as though there never was a person on the other side of the door.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Paimon thinks he's really ignoring us... Have we failed the commission?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, no matter what, we should head back and tell Nakul what happened.

choices.text: Maybe I'm just a character in someone's dreams.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Then could it be my dreams? I've heard your voices... I heard you speaking to a lively young girl.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Maybe it's Paimon's dreams? If so... It would be great to still wake up and see {NICKNAME} by Paimon's side. Hmm...

choices.text: Ask not for my identity, nor inquire as to my origins.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (What are you doing? Speaking like that will only complicate things, won't it?)

choices.text: I am Melusine.

response.speaker: Someone
response.text: #{M#With a voice like that? If you're a Melusine then I'm a Blubberbeast. Give me a break!}{F#I'm not sick, I'm absolutely fine. Stay away from me!}

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Isn't calling yourself a Melusine a little over the top!?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! So, here's what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give Nakul a detailed, blow-by-blow account of the negotiations...

dialogues.speaker: Nakul
dialogues.text: Oh... I see. Nevertheless, I always keep my word, so here the compensation we agreed upon earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Nakul
dialogues.text: Ugh... Now what am I going to do...
